settings.title: Build Your Own Bamboo Bicycle
settings.subtitle: 2-3 days. Expert guidance. A frame that's truly yours.

settings.heading: No Experience? No Problem.
settings.text: Since 2012, we've taught thousands of people — most with zero framebuilding experience — to create their own bamboo bicycles. Our workshops are designed for complete beginners. If you can hold a tool, you can build a bike.

settings.heading: What Happens Over 2-3 Days
settings.subheading: From raw bamboo to finished frame — here's your journey
settings.day1_item1: Custom geometry consultation based on your riding style
settings.day1_item2: Select your bamboo tubes from our sustainably-sourced stock
settings.day1_item3: Set up your frame in our precision jig system
settings.day1_item4: Learn tube mitering and preparation techniques
settings.day2_item1: Heat treat bamboo joints for strength
settings.day2_item2: Wrap joints with natural fibers and epoxy
settings.day2_item3: Learn the BBC lug system for perfect alignment
settings.day2_item4: Build bottom bracket and headtube assemblies
settings.day3_item2: Sand and prep for clear coat
settings.note_text: Build times vary by frame type. Road frames typically complete in 2 days. MTB and complex geometries may need 3 days.

settings.heading: Workshop Builds
settings.subheading: Frames built by first-time builders just like you

settings.heading: What's Included
settings.item1_text: All bamboo tubes, lugs, dropouts, and materials needed to build your frame
settings.item2_text: Step-by-step instruction from experienced frame builders (max 6 per session)
settings.item3_text: Access to all tools, jigs, and equipment — nothing to buy or bring
settings.item4_text: Tea, coffee, snacks, and lunch provided throughout your build days
settings.item5_text: Join our global builder community for ongoing support and inspiration
settings.item6_text: Full access to our tutorial library for component assembly and maintenance

settings.heading: What Our Workshop Graduates Say
settings.testimonial_1_quote: An incredible experience. I came with zero framebuilding experience and left with a bike I'm genuinely proud of. The instructors were patient, knowledgeable, and clearly passionate about what they do.
settings.testimonial_2_quote: Best birthday present I ever gave myself. Two days of pure focus and creativity. Now I ride past bike shops and think I made something better than anything in there.
settings.testimonial_3_quote: The small group size meant we got loads of individual attention. James and the team were brilliant at explaining the why, not just the how.

settings.heading: Workshop FAQ
settings.faq1_answer: None at all. 95% of our workshop participants have never built anything like this before. We guide you through every step, from selecting your bamboo to the final finish.
settings.faq2_answer: Just yourself and old clothes you don't mind getting epoxy on. We provide everything else — tools, materials, safety equipment, lunch, tea and coffee.
settings.faq3_answer: Absolutely! Many people book with partners or friends. Building together is a great experience. Group discounts available for 3+ bookings.
settings.faq4_question: Can I use Cycle to Work?
settings.faq4_answer: Yes! We're registered with all major Cycle to Work providers including Cyclescheme, Cycle Solutions, and Bike2Work. You can typically save 25-39%.
settings.faq5_question: How do I get my frame home?
settings.faq5_answer: Most people carry their frame on public transport or in a car boot. We can also arrange courier shipping (additional cost) if you're traveling from further away.
settings.faq6_answer: The workshop produces a complete frame ready for components. We can advise on component choices, and sell complete groupset packages separately.
settings.faq7_question: How long will the frame last?
settings.faq7_answer: With proper care, bamboo frames ride for 8-12+ years. We've had frames from our earliest workshops still going strong. Our support doesn't end when you leave.
settings.faq8_answer: Full refund if cancelled 14+ days before. 50% refund or date transfer 7-13 days before. No refund within 7 days, but you can transfer your booking to someone else.
